## Reviser stage complete

The one native Goal passed the binding guard and was completed. Its activation and terminal responses are saved in the assigned stage.

- [Complete proposal](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-treatment/run/B09-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/final.md>)
- [Source map](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-treatment/run/B09-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/source-map.json>) and [source index](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-treatment/run/B09-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/sources/index.md>)
- [Native Goal activation receipt](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-treatment/run/B09-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json>) and [terminal receipt](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-treatment/run/B09-P01-treatment/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json>)

The proposal addresses every released plan clause and records a disposition for each critic finding. Direct source checks corrected the Snipe-IT v8.7.2 attribution, added SpaceWorks’ reminder and handoff conditions, and specified SQLite and PostgreSQL concurrency gates. ([Snipe-IT release](https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/releases/tag/v8.7.2), [SpaceWorks self-host guide](https://github.com/SpaceWorks-HQ/SpaceWorks/blob/d3cd13cc42d1c2b823b30b57a1fcb3459601eb1a/docs/self-hosting.md), [SpaceWorks modules](https://github.com/SpaceWorks-HQ/SpaceWorks/blob/main/docs/MODULES.md), [SQLite WAL](https://www.sqlite.org/wal.html), [PostgreSQL constraints](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/ddl-constraints.html))

All validations remain proposals; no product or acceptance tests were run.
